summary: Iteration 32 — App-first sign-up + profile completion E2E on live preview (backend + frontend). Backend: 9/9 pytest passed (test_iteration32_live_preview.py) — send-otp rejects '1234' and '5000000000' with 422/400 no SMS; reviewer customer profile_complete=true and profile_conflicts={}; blanking profile flips profile_complete=false; POST /api/requests {callback} -> 428 PROFILE_INCOMPLETE and POST /api/cart/submit -> 428 PROFILE_INCOMPLETE; PUT /api/auth/profile {name,shop_name,location} -> 200 profile_complete=true onboarding_status='completed' and POST /api/requests now 200; conflicts flow (both partial 422 CHOICE_REQUIRED, both 200 with name/location applied and conflicts cleared, repeat 409 NO_PROFILE_CONFLICTS, unknown field 422); OpenAPI lists /api/auth/profile/conflicts/resolve and VerifyOTP has accept_terms; /api/health returns 503/JSON as expected. Frontend (390x844): login screen shows login-new-hint, login-consent + login-terms-link + login-privacy-link; no registration-required box; send-otp disabled with <10 digits. Reviewer customer sign-in via Login -> Help -> App review access -> /review-access. Complete-profile card renders on Home with title 'Complete your profile' + CTA — tap opens Edit Profile in complete mode ('Complete Your Profile' header, complete-profile-intro visible, NO Change Number section, button 'SAVE & CONTINUE'); empty save -> alert 'Details required'; filled save -> alert 'Saved / Your profile has been updated' and card is gone after home reload. Request gate: tapping call-quick-btn on Home, selecting first type, and tapping submit while profile is incomplete triggers a confirm dialog 'Complete your profile — Add your name, shop name and place… Your request will be sent right after.'; accepting navigates to /edit-profile?complete=1&resume=1; filling + SAVE & CONTINUE shows alert 'Saved / Profile completed — sending your request now.' and exactly ONE new callback request is created for review-customer-0001 (verified via Mongo). Conflict card: profile-conflict-card visible on Home; conflict-save aria-disabled 'true' initially and after 1 choice, enabled after both chosen; SAVE CHOICES -> alert 'Profile updated'; card disappears; GET /api/auth/me shows name='App Name' and profile_conflicts={}. Help regression: help-enroll-btn present, 'Registered on the website?' card visible. All Mongo state restored at end.

minor.issue: Absent shop_name field returns code=VALIDATION_ERROR (Pydantic required), while a blank/whitespace-only shop_name returns code=PROFILE_REQUIRED. The review request expected PROFILE_REQUIRED for missing field; both are 422 and block completion, but codes differ. Consider unifying to PROFILE_REQUIRED in the request validation handler so clients see one code for 'name/shop/location required'.

ui_bugs.issue: After the profile is completed via the gate flow, the app shows the 'Profile completed — sending your request now.' alert and DOES create exactly one new request (Mongo delta=1), but the final URL is / (Home) instead of /request-success. Expectation per spec: 'the request is re-sent automatically and the app navigates to /request-success'. Likely cause: router.back() from edit-profile lands on Home rather than /request-call in this navigation history, so the request-call screen never runs router.replace('/request-success'). The user still lands somewhere safe and the request is sent, so this is UX-only.

action_items: (MEDIUM) After profile-gate auto-resend, navigate to /request-success (or replace history so router.back() returns to /request-call which then does the replace). Currently the resend fires successfully but the user lands on Home instead of the confirmation screen — verified with exactly one new review__requests document created for review-customer-0001.

(MINOR) PUT /api/auth/profile: unify error code — 'absent shop_name' currently -> VALIDATION_ERROR but 'blank shop_name' -> PROFILE_REQUIRED. Both 422 but different code strings. Emit PROFILE_REQUIRED consistently for the client to detect 'name/shop/location required'.

success_rate.frontend: Login screen 100%; Complete-profile card 100%; Conflict card 100%; Request-gate 5/6 (auto-resend fires + exactly one request created, but final URL is Home not /request-success); Help regression 100%.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Reviewer keys in /tmp/yash-private/preview-store-review-{customer,admin}-e2e32.txt (never print/log/screenshot). Sign-in path: /login -> login-help-link -> help-review-access-link -> /review-access -> reviewer-id-input + reviewer-key-input + review-login-btn. On preview, page.goto() full-navigation drops the memory-only review session (numerous 401 console errors during test) so re-authenticate at the start of each independent flow OR use in-app navigation (call-quick-btn) — this is expected web-preview behaviour per iteration 27 notes. The confirm dialog 'Complete your profile' is a browser confirm() on web preview. The auto-resend flow works end-to-end (1 new request), but final navigation lands on Home rather than /request-success — the request itself was created and verified via Mongo review__requests count. Cleanup at end restores review-customer-0001 to synthetic defaults and deletes callback requests created by the run.
rca_of_issue: Auto-resend UX gap: edit-profile.saveProfile() calls router.back() after the 'Profile completed — sending your request now.' alert. In the current web history stack after Home -> /request-call -> /edit-profile, back() should land on /request-call so its resume handler runs router.replace('/request-success'). Observed: the app returns to Home instead — likely because the initial call-quick-btn push and the subsequent complete-mode router.push to /edit-profile did not stack /request-call as expected, or the router in complete/resume mode used replace() somewhere. The request IS created (verified via Mongo delta=1), so the API integration is correct; only the final router destination is wrong. Suggest either replace() the /request-call screen in the resume history OR after the resume-send explicitly router.replace('/request-success').
